takeaway: IMN Wednesday steps Pacífico Norte up a notch vs Tuesday: morning little–partly cloudy, afternoon scattered showers with storms, and coastal rains tonight (Nicoya ~32°C; Liberia ~36°C). Hurricane Polo and Hurricane Odalys remain well offshore Mexico/west EPAC with no cyclone near Costa Rica; Tehuantepec genesis is now high (~80% in 7 days) but tracks parallel to southern Mexico. Gyre/temporales watch stays elevated, not established — ensemble means keep Pacific SW low-level flow into Nicoya longer than yesterday’s GEFS trade-return signal suggested.

periods.label: Days 1–3 (Wed–Fri)
periods.pattern: Today (IMN Pacífico Norte, valid Wed 23 Sep): morning little–partly cloudy; afternoon partial–mostly cloudy with scattered showers and storms; evening partly cloudy with coastal rains. General commentary: unstable ITCZ — early Pacific maritime isolated storms possible (Pacífico Norte/Central), afternoon Pacific-side showers/storms (plus Valle Central and isolated Caribbean/Zona Norte mountains), night rainy coastal Pacific. Nicoya max ~32.1°C / min ~23.1°C (Liberia ~35.6°C). Weekly: maritime Pacific rains more evident Mon–Wed mornings; Wed onward rains/aguaceros with storm in Pac Central/Sur and Pac Norte mountains / Valle Central; OT#46 estimated this weekend with little country signal. GFS 06Z / GEFS mean 06Z / EPS mean 00Z 24-h maps keep Nicoya mostly light–moderate (~0.1–0.75 in / 24 h) through ~Thu morning. GEFS mean f024 and EPS mean f024 show light SW–W 850 onshore over Nicoya with flanking EPAC lows (EPS ~981 hPa class feature well west of southern Mexico/Guatemala) — moist monsoon trough / ITCZ, not a closed land gyre. Papagayo variable <5–light, seas ~3–6 ft (NHC OFFPZ8 PMZ113).
periods.implications: Mornings still the better outdoor window; plan around scattered afternoon storms and overnight coastal rains. Inland Guanacaste stays very hot (Liberia mid–upper 30s).
periods.confidence: High for no nearby TC and continued ITCZ shower/storm chances (IMN + NHC). Moderate on exact Nosara timing/amounts (IMN scattered-storms language vs light–moderate ensemble means).

periods.label: Days 4–7 (Sat–Tue)
periods.pattern: Sat (~26 Sep): GEFS mean 06Z f072 keeps SW–W 850 over Nicoya with ~1002 hPa EPAC L south of Mexico/Guatemala; EPS mean 00Z f072 / epac panel shows deeper ~989 hPa EPAC L near ~15°N/110°W and clear SW onshore ~10 kt on Nicoya; AIFS-ENS 00Z f072 similar (~992 hPa L south of Tehuantepec, W–SW 850). GFS deterministic 06Z epac f072 shows deep TC-type centers well west (~961 / ~990 hPa class) plus a weaker ~1006 hPa L south of Tehuantepec — treat deep features as Mexico-parallel TC environment (Polo / next genesis), not a Costa Rica gyre. 24-h means: GEFS Nicoya still ~0.3–0.75 in; EPS ~0.4–0.75 in; AIFS-ENS ~0.2–0.5 in; ECMWF det namer precip in a similar light–moderate band over Guanacaste. By ~Mon 28 (f120), GEFS mean still shows light SW–W 850 over Nicoya (not the clean E–NE trade flip seen yesterday) with precip light ~0.1–0.4 in; EPS f120 wetter over Nicoya ~0.5–1.0 in; AIFS-ENS f120 keeps SW with ~995 hPa Mexico-coast L. NHC OFFPZ8 synopsis: moderate-or-weaker winds except moderate–fresh offshore El Salvador/Guatemala Thu into early Sat as a low forms south of the Gulf of Tehuantepec. Not locked as a multi-day temporal or closed Central American gyre.
periods.implications: Keep late-day plans flexible Sat–Mon if SW moisture holds; treat wetter EPS frames as a moisture signal, not a guaranteed temporales. Marine: Papagayo mostly light/variable with seas ~3–6 ft; sharper wind bump remains El Salvador/Guatemala waters (NHC).
periods.confidence: Moderate for continued shower chances and persistent SW-moisture signal; low–moderate for sustained temporales or a closed Central American gyre (ensemble means lack a closed land gyre; Nicoya precip stays mostly light–moderate).

periods.label: Days 8–15
periods.pattern: IMN sub-seasonal (21 Sep–18 Oct) still keeps Pacífico Norte below normal (weekly Pac Norte roughly 5–90 mm for 21–27 Sep and again 28 Sep–4 Oct) with stronger-than-usual trades limiting Pacific-side rain in the official narrative. CPC GTH text updated 22 Sep (valid 30 Sep–13 Oct): El Niño background; week-2/3 EPAC genesis areas lean Mexico / open EPAC, not CR; no CR-focused extreme rainfall call in the discussion excerpt. GEFS mean f168 (~30 Sep) still shows light SW–WSW 850 over Nicoya and light precip (~0.1–0.4 in / 24 h) without a local extreme bullseye or closed land gyre; heavy EPAC precip stays offshore Mexico. Single deterministic frames can still show a wetter day — treat as scenario only.
periods.implications: No official signal for a prolonged flood-season spike on the Nicoya Pacific side; short heavy cells remain possible.
periods.confidence: Moderate for below-normal / no major local TC theme; low for day-by-day rain.

gyreWatch.possibleTiming: Roughly midweek into the weekend (~Thu–Sun 24–28 Sep) while flanking EPAC lows and Pacific SW low-level flow persist; GEFS mean no longer cleanly flips Nicoya to trades by ~Sun as it did yesterday
gyreWatch.supporting: GEFS mean 06Z f024–f120 shows SW–W 850 over Nicoya with EPAC Ls ~1002–1003 hPa class; EPS mean 00Z f024–f120 and AIFS-ENS 00Z f072–f120 keep SW onshore fetch and deep EPAC lows (~981–995 hPa class, Tehuantepec / southern Mexico parallel). NHC OFFPZ8 still allows a low south of Tehuantepec with fresher El Salvador/Guatemala winds Thu–early Sat. Short-term IMN ITCZ / Pac Norte afternoon storms + coastal night rains support a moist Pacific start. Versus yesterday, GEFS mean keeps onshore SW longer (through f120–f168) instead of returning trades by ~Sun.
gyreWatch.conflicting: Ensemble means do not show a closed gyre centered over Central America — pattern is flanking EPAC lows / monsoon trough plus SW moisture. GFS det deep EPAC lows are TC-type features near Mexico (Polo / next Tehuantepec system), not a CR gyre. Ensemble-mean Nicoya precip stays mostly light–moderate with EPS a bit wetter than GEFS midweek. NHC has no disturbance near Costa Rica (Hurricane Polo and Hurricane Odalys well west/NW; Tehuantepec genesis 80% in 7 days tracks parallel to southern/southwestern Mexico). IMN sub-seasonal still favors Pacific rainfall deficit. Ensemble means only — no member-count probabilities.

whatChanged: Odalys upgraded to hurricane (still far from CR); Tehuantepec genesis area up to ~80% in 7 days (was ~60%). IMN Pac Norte afternoon language stronger today (scattered showers with storms) vs Tuesday’s possible isolated rain; Nicoya max a touch cooler (~32°C vs ~33°C). Biggest model shift vs Tue: GEFS mean 06Z no longer turns Nicoya cleanly back to E–NE trades by ~Sun — SW–W 850 persists into f120–f168, so the SW-moisture window looks a bit longer even though precip means remain mostly light–moderate. NHC OFFPZ8 theme unchanged (Tehuantepec low; Papagayo light). Latest listed IMN aviso is Tue 22 Sep afternoon ITCZ showers — no new Wednesday aviso on the list at collection time.
practical: Best apparent outdoor windows: mornings Wed–Fri before the convective peak, noting IMN now has scattered afternoon storms on Pac Norte (not just possible isolated rain). Worth planning around: overnight coastal rains, very warm inland heat (Liberia ~36°C; Nicoya ~32°C), and Papagayo light/variable with seas ~3–6 ft (NHC OFFPZ8 PMZ113). Watch Thu–Sat if SW moisture and the Tehuantepec/El Salvador–Guatemala low verify wetter than GEFS. No new Wednesday IMN aviso listed yet — latest is Tue 22 Sep.
